title: Tools return empty/error responses after game_over, models spin without exiting
description:
After a game ends, tool calls return empty error responses (e.g. `{"error":""}` from pass_priority). The pilot only detects game_over from pass_priority results (pilot.py:682), but:

1. Models often call get_action_choices first (which returns game_over:true), then produce text-only responses instead of calling pass_priority
2. GPT5n Coach in game_20260214_185313_g1 produced 16 consecutive text-only LLM responses between receiving game_over and finally calling pass_priority (seq=297-329), wasting tokens
3. GPT5n Libby in game_20260214_142305_g3 had the same pattern (2 text-only responses)

The empty error from pass_priority (`{"error":""}`) is unhelpful - the model doesn't know why the tool failed and tries to troubleshoot. The model says things like "pass_priority/get_action_choices calls are returning no data" and "the system keeps returning empty data."

Possible fixes:
- The pilot should detect game_over from get_action_choices results too, not just pass_priority
- Tools should return a clear `{"game_over":true, "message":"Game has ended"}` response instead of empty errors
- The pilot could auto-detect text-only LLM responses (no tool calls) after game_over and force exit

Key log references:
- game_20260214_185313_g1/GPT5n Coach_llm.jsonl seq=295 (game_over from get_action_choices), seq=297-329 (16 text-only responses)
- game_20260214_142305_g3/GPT5n Libby_llm.jsonl seq=709 (model complains about empty data)
